mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in a month coincides with a 5-day forward S&P 500 return of +1.5%, as higher expected inflation raises discount rates and reduces equity present value.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not outperform a 0.2% inflation baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return, as higher labor costs signal wage pressures that depress corporate profit expectations.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.5% in the current month
failure_condition: In regimes with stable labor costs, the same labor cost increase yields positive or neutral 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 95 triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a structural supply shock that may support higher equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95 in the current month
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day or 60-day forward return in 10 consecutive such INDPRO contractions (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly drop in both HOUST and RSAFS retail sales (>2% and >1% respectively) predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak demand raises recession risk.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prev AND RSAFS < prev by >2% and >1% respectively in the current month
failure_condition: In 20 out of 50 such dual weak-demand months, 20-day forward returns are not statistically worse than average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% produces a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate lower policy rates and easier financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 1% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 100 such months, 60-day forward returns do not exceed a 0.2% rate baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a positive 20-day forward return as lower unemployment expectations boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: In regimes with rising UNRATE, the same pattern does not produce a positive 20-day return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% combined with a simultaneous 1% decline in INDPRO suggests a demand-supply imbalance that is associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls by >2% AND INDPRO falls by >1% in the current month
failure_condition: In 50 such events, the 5-day forward return is not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in FEDFUNDS above 5.25% in a single month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate higher policy rates and tighter credit conditions.
failure_condition: Over 10 such spikes, the 20-day forward return does not fall below -0.5% (p > 0.05).
